title: The British New Wave
description: Driven by a group of critics turned filmmakers, the movement produced great films portraying the British working class.

title: Latin American Cinema
description: The 1960s were a fervent decade for Latin American cinema, led by Cinema Novo in Brazil.

title: New Hollywood
description: A new era arrived in Hollywood in the 1960s, with new directors who would go on to become landmarks of the craft.

title: Sex and Taboos on Film
description: The effervescent 1960s brought a new attitude toward sex, youth, drugs and personal freedom, influencing the arts as a whole and pushing censorship to its limits.

title: Spy Films
description: The decade in which spy films gained great examples such as the 007 series.

title: Science Fiction on Film
description: After a considerable golden age, science fiction films came of age in the 1960s.

title: Modern Horror on Film
description: Much more than a series of scares and chills, horror films of the 1960s often used the genre as a vehicle to address broader themes.

title: The Spaghetti Western
description: The decade in which the Western began its rebirth in Europe.
